submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective template-continuation head: it fires when the current token continues a repeated parallel formatted structure — a later row of an enumerated or dash-delimited list, a repeated 'Label: value' or 'Label - value' pair, a repeated '(Author et al., YEAR)' citation, or a repeated delimited code or math assignment — attending back with near-1.0 weight to the matching delimiter of an earlier chunk, with strength growing on the second and later repeats. A lone unrepeated item, a lone heading, or ordinary non-repeating prose stays near floor.

rival_explanations: It is a generic long-range punctuation-retrieval head that fires whenever the current segment closes any formatted chunk (any colon, dash, bracket, or newline), whether or not any structure repeats.

It is a narrow list-label and citation detector that fires only on enumerated-list ordinals and month names ('3.', ' March') and on the 'et al.' bigram, and not on other repeated templates such as code assignments or colon-separated pairs.
